classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Swords and two-handed swords. A front-line fighter who either cleaves packs apart or becomes an iron wall.

doctrines.name: Blade
doctrines.description: Offensive sword arts, whirlwinds and sweeping area damage.

doctrines.name: Iron Body
doctrines.description: Defensive stance, heavy armour and unyielding endurance.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: Daggers and bows. Strikes from the shadows for burst damage or picks enemies apart from range.

doctrines.name: Shadow
doctrines.description: Stealth, ambush strikes and close-range execution.

doctrines.name: Hawk
doctrines.description: Archery, mobility and precise ranged pressure.

classes.name: Hexblade
classes.description: A sword bound to a curse. Fights in melee with dark buffs or hurls cursed magic from afar.

doctrines.name: Cursed Steel
doctrines.description: Melee strikes empowered by self-buffs and curses.

doctrines.name: Dark Arts
doctrines.description: Ranged shadow magic and area corruption.

classes.name: Mystic
classes.description: Bells and fans. Channels dragon spirits for destruction or grace for healing and protection.

doctrines.name: Dragon
doctrines.description: Offensive elemental magic and spirit summons.
